boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten map-listed destinations on Temple’s campus-edge corridors, each with one directly sourced reason to stop by.

cards.title: Liacouras Center for arena events
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the venue calendar before heading to 1776 N. Broad Street; Temple identifies it as a multipurpose arena for concerts, family shows and basketball.
cards.short_summary: A North Broad arena with a varied event program.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple describes the Liacouras Center as a multipurpose venue on Broad Street hosting concerts, family shows and Temple basketball games.
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticket requirements vary; consult the venue’s current event listing.

cards.title: Temple Performing Arts Center for scheduled programs
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Look for public-facing performances or programs at 1837 N. Broad Street; Temple uses this location for New Owl Experience sessions and other events.
cards.short_summary: A named North Broad venue used for university programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple lists the Temple Performing Arts Center at 1837 N. Broad Street as the location for its in-person New Owl Experience.
cards.source_title: In-Person New Owl Experience | Temple University
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled program; verify event details before visiting.

cards.title: Rock Hall Auditorium for concert programming
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the event listing to time a visit to Rock Hall at 1715 N. Broad Street; Temple’s program identified the auditorium for a Cybersounds concert.
cards.short_summary: A North Broad auditorium documented as an event site.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple’s Office of the President listed Rock Hall at 1715 N. Broad Street as the site of a Cybersounds concert.
cards.source_title: Maps and Directions | Office of the President | Temple University
cards.access_notes: Building and event access may be limited to scheduled programs.

cards.title: Howard Gittis Student Center for services
cards.subtitle: 13th Street and Montgomery Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 13th Street and Montgomery Avenue when you need campus basics; Temple lists a food court, game room, bookstore and Student Affairs offices here.
cards.short_summary: A student-services stop with food, games and the bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple identifies the Howard Gittis Student Center at 13th Street and Montgomery Avenue and lists its food court, game room, bookstore and Student Affairs offices.
cards.access_notes: Individual offices, food outlets and the bookstore set their own hours and purchase requirements.

cards.entity_name: Independence Blue Cross Student Recreation Center
cards.title: IBC Student Recreation Center for recreation
cards.subtitle: 15th Street and Liacouras Walk corridor
cards.notes: Plan a recreation session at 1701 N. 15th Street, across from Liacouras Garage; Temple publishes separate operating hours for the IBC Student Rec Center.
cards.short_summary: A 15th Street recreation facility with posted operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple lists the IBC Student Recreation Center at 1701 North 15th Street and publishes its hours of operation.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Campus Recreation eligibility, policies and the currently posted hours.

cards.title: Geasey Outdoor Turf for posted open recreation
cards.subtitle: 15th Street and Polett Walk corridor
cards.notes: Check the weekly schedule before walking to 15th Street at Polett Walk; Temple posts open-recreation hours for the Geasey Outdoor Turf Complex.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor turf complex with weekly posted recreation time.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple locates Geasey Outdoor Turf at 15th Street and Polett Walk and states that open recreation hours are posted weekly.
cards.access_notes: Open recreation availability changes weekly and can be affected by weather or surface conditions.

cards.title: Temple Tennis Courts by Norris Street
cards.subtitle: 15th Street and Norris Street corridor
cards.notes: Use Temple’s listed location, 15th Street and Norris Street, to find the named tennis courts; check campus recreation guidance before planning court time.
cards.short_summary: Named campus tennis courts at the 15th-and-Norris corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple’s Campus Recreation page lists its Tennis Courts at 15th Street and Norris Street.
cards.access_notes: Confirm availability and any recreation policies with Campus Recreation before visiting.

cards.title: Weiss Hall for its accessible Cecil B. Moore entrance
cards.subtitle: Cecil B. Moore Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Approach Weiss Hall at 13th Street and Cecil B. Moore Avenue via its Cecil B. Moore entrance, which Temple identifies as ADA accessible.
cards.short_summary: A named hall with an ADA-accessible entrance on Cecil B. Moore.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple states that Weiss Hall’s Cecil B. Moore Avenue entrance is ADA accessible and places the building at 13th Street and Cecil B. Moore Avenue.
cards.source_title: Contact & Directions | Temple Mood and Cognition Lab
cards.access_notes: Interior access may require building entry procedures; use the accessible entrance as directed.

cards.title: Temple University Station for Regional Rail access
cards.subtitle: 10th Street and Berks Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the station at 10th and Berks streets when arriving by Regional Rail; Temple says all SEPTA Regional Rail lines stop at Temple University Station.
cards.short_summary: A Berks Street rail arrival point for Temple’s Main Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple states that all SEPTA Regional Rail lines stop at Temple University Station, located at 10th and Berks streets.
cards.source_title: Getting to Campus | Temple University Graduate School
cards.access_notes: Fares and service conditions are set by SEPTA; verify the current schedule before travel.

cards.title: Liacouras Garage for public campus parking
cards.subtitle: 15th Street corridor between Montgomery and Cecil B. Moore avenues
cards.notes: Use 15th Street between Montgomery and Cecil B. Moore avenues for this named public garage when driving to Main Campus; payment is required.
cards.short_summary: A public Main Campus garage on the 15th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple identifies Liacouras Garage as a public Main Campus parking garage on 15th Street between Montgomery and Cecil B. Moore avenues.
cards.access_notes: Public parking is available; Temple states that credit cards and cash are accepted.
